research_scope: Direct-source follow-up on six canonical skills retaining null race_restriction: Backflip, Break Strike, Consecutive Energy Blast, Energy Wave Combo, Power Pole Combo, Turn Retreat.

records.name: Backflip
records.evidence: External technique references identify Backflip as a Future Warrior-purchasable Super Skill and list it among Future Warrior techniques; no narrower race/gender/form restriction is stated.

records.name: Break Strike
records.evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill reference identifies Skill Shop acquisition and describes it as a common Evasive used by a wide range of characters; this does not establish a narrower CaC race restriction.

records.name: Consecutive Energy Blast
records.evidence: Current skill reference identifies Skill Shop acquisition; the Future Warrior/CaC technique corpus and character-use evidence establish availability context but no narrower race/gender/form restriction.

records.name: Energy Wave Combo
records.evidence: Current skill reference identifies Skill Shop acquisition and broad character use; no narrower CaC race/gender/form restriction is stated.

records.name: Power Pole Combo
records.evidence: Current sources identify Power Pole Combo as a purchasable Super Attack and as a Future Warrior-usable technique; no direct race/gender restriction for the skill itself was established.

records.name: Turn Retreat
records.evidence: Current technique reference explicitly identifies purchase by the Future Warrior and the Evasive Skill reference lists it among CaC-available Evasives; no narrower race/gender/form restriction is stated.

policy: Null race_restriction remains an unresolved enrichment field. CaC availability or broad character use is not sufficient to promote null to unrestricted or to a specific race.
next: Continue remaining null-race cohort with direct evidence; prioritize records where a source explicitly names a Future Warrior race/gender/form condition.
